name: Reticulum
introduction: is the Reticle, the crosshairs in a telescope eyepiece, introduced by Nicolas-Louis de Lacaille in the 1750s. It is a small diamond of stars near the Large Magellanic Cloud.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: Zeta Reticuli, a pair of Sun-like stars about 39 light-years away, became famous in UFO lore after the 1960s Betty and Barney Hill story. Astronomers have found a dust disk around one of them, but no planets so far.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Rhombus](hip:19780), Alpha Reticuli, is a yellow giant 160 light-years away. [Beta Reticuli](hip:17440) is an orange giant, and [Epsilon Reticuli](hip:19921) has a giant planet.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Close to the Large Magellanic Cloud, Reticulum also contains NGC 1559, a barred spiral galaxy that has hosted several supernovae.
